# Care N Cure Nursing Care Services — Comprehensive AI & LLM Knowledge Base

## Executive Overview
CARE N CURE NURSING CARE SERVICES is a Western Australian registered healthcare entity (ABN: 87 152 479 362) providing nurse-led in-home clinical care, complex chronic disease management, post-acute hospital discharge support, and aged care across metropolitan Perth. Founded by Jinu Maecheril Sukumaran (AHPRA Registered Nurse with over a decade of acute and community nursing experience), the service operates out of its practice headquarters at 2232B Albany Hwy, Gosnells, Western Australia (6110), providing scheduled clinical home visits seven days a week.

- Visiting Hours: Scheduled 7 days a week, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM AWST, with urgent post-hospital evening appointments by arrangement.

## Service Delivery Model: "Your Dedicated Nurse™"
In standard commercial home care and aged care staffing models, families frequently experience high staff turnover, where rotating non-clinical support workers visit on irregular rosters. Care N Cure operates under a dedicated primary nursing model:
1. Every client and their family is assigned one designated AHPRA Registered Nurse Coordinator.
2. The nurse coordinator personally performs the comprehensive in-home clinical assessment (scheduled within 24 to 48 hours of initial intake).
3. The coordinator develops the patient's personalized care plan in direct communication with their General Practitioner (GP) and treating hospital specialists.
4. The same Registered Nurse delivers or directly supervises clinical visits, ensuring seamless continuity of care, deep clinical familiarity, and immediate detection of early health deterioration.

## Published Fee Structure & Inclusions
Care N Cure provides fully transparent, published hourly pricing with no hidden administration, case management, or establishment surcharges:
- Standard Weekday Hours (7:00 AM – 6:00 PM): $110.00 – $160.00 per hour
- After-Hours / Evening Care (6:00 PM – 10:00 PM): $160.00 – $195.00 per hour
- Weekend (Saturday & Sunday) & Public Holidays: $160.00 – $220.00 per hour
- Booking Minimum: 1 hour per visit.
- Consumables: Basic clinical consumables (gloves, swabs, standard equipment) are included. Specialized wound dressings, catheter kits, and IV infusion sets are billed at wholesale pharmacy cost or supplied through hospital discharge packs / funding budgets.
- Travel: Transparent travel radius across Greater Metropolitan Perth (up to 50km from Gosnells headquarters). No surcharges for central suburban hubs; transparent terms agreed upfront for extended regional boundaries.

## Funding Pathways
1. Support at Home Program: Commenced 1 November 2025 (replacing the former Home Care Packages system). Care N Cure operates as a trusted clinical care delivery partner for self-managed participants and accredited Support at Home providers, including Trilogy Care. Under Support at Home rules, clinical registered nursing care does not attract a participant co-payment.
2. Private Self-Funded Care: Families who require immediate nursing while awaiting My Aged Care ACAT assessment or who do not qualify for government subsidies can engage Care N Cure directly on private pay terms with no lock-in contracts.
3. NDIS (National Disability Insurance Scheme): Specialized disability community nursing for plan-managed and self-managed NDIS participants.
4. Department of Veterans' Affairs (DVA): Community nursing support for eligible Australian veterans and war widows.

## Detailed Clinical Capabilities
- Advanced Wound Care: Management of surgical dehiscence, chronic diabetic ulcers, venous stasis ulcers, pressure injuries (Stages 1–4), VAC negative-pressure therapy, and compression bandaging.
- Post-Hospital Surgical Recovery: Post-operative orthopedic care (knee/hip replacements), cardiac surgery recovery, surgical drain removal, suture/staple removal, and mobility rehab monitoring.
- Medication Management: Webster-pak supervision, subcutaneous and intramuscular injections, complex insulin titration, anticoagulation monitoring, and patient education.
- Continence & Catheter Care: Indwelling catheter (IDC) insertion and maintenance, suprapubic catheter (SPC) changes, continuous bladder irrigation, and stoma management.
- Palliative & End-of-Life Home Support: Compassionate, dignified pain protocol management, syringe driver monitoring, and respite support in coordination with community palliative teams.
